sloka: अलमेनं परिक्लिश्य लोकं मोहनिराकृतम् ।जित एव त्वया सौम्य मर्त्यलोको न संशयः ।। ७.२०.१५ ॥
transliteration: alamenaṁ parikliśya lokaṁ mohanirākṛtam ।jita eva tvayā saumya martyaloko na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.20.15 ॥

translations.english: Deluded by affection for parents, children, charming wives, and relatives, this afflicted person does not comprehend his own suffering.
